description: The plot titled “ChatGPT on Songs” illustrates how three measured values (Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment) vary with Question Popularity. The x-axis is labeled “Question Popularity,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 5 to 26 with major tick labels at 5-unit intervals (5, 10, 15, 20, 25). The y-axis is labeled “Values,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0.55 to 1.00 with tick labels spaced by 0.05. Three lines are shown: (1) Accuracy is a blue solid line with circular markers, starting near 0.66 at popularity 5, dipping to about 0.60 at 5.5, then rising with fluctuations (around 0.68 at 7, ~0.76 at 8.5, ~0.75 at 10), reaching about 0.81 at 11.5, dropping to ~0.72 at 14, then increasing to ~0.81 at 17 and ending near 0.88 at 26; (2) Confidence is a green solid line with upward triangle markers, starting around 0.93 at popularity 5, staying in the low-to-mid 0.90s through 14 (e.g., ~0.92–0.96 with a local high near ~0.965 at 10 and a dip near ~0.94 at 14), then rising to about 0.97 at 17 and ending near 0.98 at 26; (3) Alignment is a red solid line with square markers, beginning around 0.73 at popularity 5, dropping to about 0.68 at 5.5, then increasing with oscillations (about 0.75 at 6.5, ~0.74 at 7.5, ~0.80 at 8.5, ~0.78 at 10), reaching ~0.86 at 11.5, decreasing to ~0.78 at 14, then rising to ~0.84 at 17 and ending near 0.90 at 26.
